effect.name: GM Voxel Elevation Map
effect.desc: Splits the layer into a grid of cells, reads each cell's brightness as an elevation, and rebuilds the picture as a relief of blocks. Four build styles: Voxel Blocks gives every cell a raised top face and a shaded front face, Isometric Columns slides the top face sideways so the blocks read as solid 3D, Height Bars turns each cell into a free-standing column, and Dot Matrix grows a disc whose radius is the elevation. Height scale, height snapping, cell gap, face depth, edge bevel, an isometric offset, a shading angle and a cell outline are all separate. Layer space, so the blocks are cut from the layer itself.
